title: Matters
description: Cases and legal matters tracked by your firm
newDescription: Open a new case or legal matter
emptyHint: Matters only appear if you are assigned (or in an assigned group). When creating a matter, include yourself under Assigned users.

comments.placeholderDescription: Comment threads are not included in Firmedware core. Implement a Comment model in your fork when your firm needs matter discussions — keep attorney work product in your DMS where permissions are enforced.

groups.none: No active groups. An admin can create groups under Admin → Groups.

error.noPermissionCreate: You do not have permission to create matters.
error.noPermissionEdit: You do not have permission to edit matters.
error.notFoundOrDenied: Matter not found or access denied.
error.noPermissionDelete: You do not have permission to delete matters.
